stem.text: An investigation was carried out on the effect of temperature on the activity of an enzyme when it is immobilised and when it is non-immobilised (free in solution). The product of the enzyme-catalysed reaction causes a decrease in pH.
The graph shows the results of the investigation.

stem.alt: Line graph of pH against time with four curves, dashed, dash-dot, dotted and solid, and a key listing non-immobilised 75 °C, immobilised 75 °C, immobilised 37 °C and non-immobilised 37 °C.

stem.text: Which would give the highest yield of product?
